title: Mueller Corp. Budget, Board Rules, New Leadership
meeting_type: Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board of Directors MLGC Meeting
summary:
*   **Approved the Mueller Local Government Corporation's operating budget** for the 2021-2022 fiscal year.
*   **Updated corporation bylaws**, changing rules for conducting board meetings and appointing members and officers.
*   **Confirmed new leadership**, appointing Diana Thomas as Vice-President and Sylnovia Holt-Rabb as Secretary.
